│ Chat composer: what is wrong with Enter when images are attached? Today, with
│ no text and uploaded images, Enter sends a message holding only the image
│ paths. A test covers this via the Send button, so it looks deliberate. While
│ an upload is running, Enter silently does nothing. Typed text was not lost
│ anywhere I traced in the code.

❯ 1. Block image-only send
     Images alone must not send: Enter and the Send button both require typed
     text. Reverses the current image-only behavior and its test.
  2. Block on Enter only
     Enter does nothing with an empty prompt, so a stray Enter can't send. The
     Send button can still send images alone.
  3. Enter should send, doesn't
     You pressed Enter with images and an empty prompt and nothing was sent.
     Fix: queue the send until uploads finish, or show why it was held.
  4. Sent, but text/images lost
     The message went out but the agent got an empty prompt or no images, even
     though you typed text or attached them. I'd trace the send/paste path.
  5. Type something.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  6. Chat about this

Enter to select · ↑/↓ to navigate · Esc to cancel
